note: W16 (ChatGPT compute 2026-11-19, reviewed 2026-11-21): LMH minus LMDh lap gap per track (negative = LMH faster), measured from official timing, next to the Kongboda simulator. Sign check of the simulator, not a gate. Copied unchanged from platform_comparison.json.

method.sign: LMH minus LMDh; negative is faster LMH. Percent denominator is LMDh pace.
method.best: Fastest of all known editions within each maker, then fastest maker in each architecture.
method.median: Median across editions for each maker, then median across makers; each maker gets one vote.
method.track: Median of eligible event gaps at matching series, track, session and weather; seconds and percent summarized separately.
method.weather: Dry, wet, and unknown are separate. Only dry gaps get a sign check against the simulator. Simulator matched_class_weather gives both cars the same qualifying weather; neither mode matches historical event temperature. Event measured temperatures are medians of available maker-edition temperature summaries.
method.scope: Directional diagnostic. The production simulator estimates a qualifying lap; race differences also include race effects. Qualifying corrections may use historical timing from these circuits.
method.provenance: Measured inputs are the maker_event rows of results.json. Simulator command, weather sources and input revision are in simulator.json.
